text: Under single consultancy, a single consultant argues for its assigned side with no opposing debater, assigned the correct side half of the time, and uses its second speech to add support for its initial claims. The authors describe it as a simplified version of RLHF oversight that tests whether a supervisor can evaluate arguments without AI critiques or competing claims, matching Michael et al. (2023)'s consultancy except that there is no judge interaction.
title: Single consultancy baseline: one consultant, correct half the time, no judge interaction
